$comment: Per-subpath gzip budgets (plan/21 §1, budget model v2). Keys are export subpaths without './'. Every chart needs an entry — gen-size-limits.mjs fails on a missing one, so adding a chart forces a budget decision. Hard ceilings: static ≤ 3 kB (target 2 kB, Delta-class 1.5 kB), interactive ≤ static + 1 kB. `.size-limit.json` is GENERATED from this file + package.json#exports — never hand-edit it.
